steps.name: Home
steps.goal: Reach Home. Dismiss Apple Account Verification with Not Now if shown. Accept the AI data notice for this isolated demo fixture if shown. Do not send a message.

steps.name: Show the project updates
steps.goal: Tap the api-gateway folder chip at the top. Do not tap add or send a message.
steps.done: The api-gateway project is selected and the updates pill is visible.

steps.name: Compact Updates rows
steps.goal: Tap 4 updates from auto agents. Open. Inspect the compact one-line rows. Do not open a report yet.
steps.done: Updates shows compact single-line agent rows with leading severity dots, plain counts and times. Review open PRs is above Triage new bug reports.

steps.name: Compact report rows
steps.goal: Tap Review open PRs in Updates. Inspect the order. Latest PR update must be above Earlier urgent PR finding despite its lower severity and earlier first sight.
steps.done: The report shows compact plain finding rows. Latest PR update is above Earlier urgent PR finding.

steps.name: Compact finding detail
steps.done: The latest finding is open with its occurrence count and a Start session action.

steps.name: Agent picker remains available
steps.goal: Tap Session agent Claude, Sonnet. Change agent or model.
steps.done: The agent picker opens with Claude and Codex choices.

steps.name: Return to the compact finding
steps.done: The compact finding and its actions are visible again.

steps.name: Launch error retains the finding
steps.goal: Tap Start session once. This isolated demo intentionally returns no session id. Do not tap it again.
steps.done: The error leaves the compact finding open with its actions.
expect: The session did not start. Please try again.
